ei.title: 7번: The Urgency Instinct and Risk Perception
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: The urgency instinct is what allows people to act quickly when faced with danger. It is particularly useful in emergency situations, where making quick decisions is essential. However, in non-emergency situations, it can cause people to panic and make poor decisions. One example of the urgency instinct in mass media is the fear of terrorism. People in the Western world fear terrorism more than heart disease, despite the fact that heart disease represents a much greater threat. The reason for this is the media's coverage of terrorist attacks, which greatly exaggerates the threat of terrorism. In reality, the possibility of being killed in a terrorist attack is extremely low. The chances of dying from heart disease, on the other hand, are much higher. The urgency instinct causes us to feel that immediate action is required to combat terrorism, even though there are many more significant threats. This is why rational analysis is required. It allows us to counteract the urgency instinct and respond to risks accordingly.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) useful=유용한 / useless=쓸모없는 (B) exaggerates=과장하다 / downplays=축소하다 (C) counteract=상쇄하다 / reinforce=강화하다
det.analysis:
① useful—exaggerates—counteract: 긴급 본능은 위급 상황에 '유용'하고, 언론은 위협을 '과장'하며, 이성적 분석은 본능을 '상쇄'한다 ←정답
② useless: 위급 상황에 쓸모없다? 문맥 반대
③ downplays/reinforce: 축소하다/강화하다는 문맥과 반대
④ useless/reinforce: 쓸모없는/강화하다는 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 위급 시 useful → 언론은 exaggerates → 이성분석은 counteract 흐름

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) allows=하게 하다 / prevents=막다 (B) greater=더 큰 / smaller=더 작은 (C) significant=중요한 / minor=사소한
det.analysis:

④ prevents/smaller/minor: 모두 문맥과 반대

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) quickly=빠르게 / slowly=느리게 (B) low=낮은 / high=높은 (C) rational=이성적인 / emotional=감정적인
det.analysis:

④ slowly/high/emotional: 모두 문맥과 반대

det.tip: act의 다의어: (연극의) 막(명사) vs 행동하다(동사)

det.korean: coverage=(언론의) 보도 / analysis=분석 / instinct=본능 / warning=경고

questions.passage: The urgency instinct is what allows people to act quickly when faced with danger. It is particularly useful in emergency situations, where __________ (make) quick decisions is essential.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: make(동사: 하다) → making(동명사). 문장의 주어 역할을 하는 동명사
det.analysis: make를 동명사 making으로 변환. 'where making quick decisions is essential' — 관계부사절에서 is의 주어 자리에 동명사가 필요하다. '빠른 결정을 내리는 것' 해석이 단서
det.tip: is의 주어 자리 → 동명사(-ing) → making

questions.passage: In reality, the possibility of __________ (be) killed in a terrorist attack is extremely low. The chances of dying from heart disease, on the other hand, are much higher.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: be(동사: ~이다) → being(동명사). 전치사 of의 목적어 + 수동(being killed)
det.analysis: be를 동명사 being으로 변환. 'the possibility of being killed' — 전치사 of의 목적어 자리이며 '죽임을 당할' 수동 의미이므로 being killed가 된다. 전치사 뒤 + 수동태 동명사
det.tip: 전치사 of 뒤 + 수동(killed) → being killed

questions.passage: The urgency instinct is what allows people to act quickly when faced with danger. It is particularly useful in emergency situations, where making quick decisions is essential. However, in non-emergency situations, it can cause people to panic and make __________. One example of the urgency instinct in mass media is the fear of terrorism. People in the Western world fear terrorism more than heart disease, despite the fact that heart disease represents a much greater threat. The reason for this is the media's coverage of terrorist attacks, which greatly exaggerates the threat of terrorism. In reality, the possibility of being killed in a terrorist attack is extremely low. The chances of dying from heart disease, on the other hand, are much higher. The urgency instinct causes us to feel that immediate action is required to combat terrorism, even though there are many more significant threats. This is why rational analysis is required. It allows us to counteract the urgency instinct and respond to risks accordingly.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: quick decisions=빠른 결정 / rational analysis=이성적 분석 / poor decisions=잘못된 결정 / immediate action=즉각적 행동
det.analysis:
① quick decisions: 빠른 결정 — 위급 상황에서는 유용하나 여기선 비위급 상황
② rational analysis: 이성적 분석 — panic(공황)과 어울리지 않음
③ poor decisions: 잘못된 결정 — 비위급 상황에서 공황에 빠져 '잘못된 결정'을 내림 ←정답
④ immediate action: 즉각적 행동 — make와 연결이 부자연스러움
det.tip: However, in non-emergency + panic → make poor decisions(잘못된 결정)

questions.passage: The urgency instinct is what allows people to act quickly when faced with danger. It is particularly useful in emergency situations, where making quick decisions is essential. However, in non-emergency situations, it can cause people to panic and make poor decisions. One example of the urgency instinct in mass media is the fear of terrorism. People in the Western world fear terrorism more than heart disease, despite the fact that heart disease represents a much greater threat. The reason for this is the media's coverage of terrorist attacks, which greatly exaggerates the threat of terrorism. In reality, the possibility of being killed in a terrorist attack is extremely low. The chances of dying from heart disease, on the other hand, are much higher. The urgency instinct causes us to feel that immediate action is required to combat terrorism, even though there are many more significant threats. This is why __________ is required. It allows us to counteract the urgency instinct and respond to risks accordingly.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: immediate action=즉각적 행동 / rational analysis=이성적 분석 / mass media=대중 매체 / greater threat=더 큰 위협
det.analysis:
① immediate action: 즉각적 행동 — 긴급 본능이 유발하는 것이지 본능을 상쇄하지 못함
② rational analysis: 이성적 분석 — 긴급 본능을 '상쇄(counteract)'하게 해주는 것 ←정답
③ mass media: 대중 매체 — 오히려 공포를 부추김
④ greater threat: 더 큰 위협 — 문맥 부적절
det.tip: This is why ___ is required. It allows us to counteract the urgency instinct → rational analysis
